$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-BLOCK-SCOPE-CONST-OBJECTS-VALUE-IN-A-STATIC-INITIALIZER-IS-REFUSED): a static local's initializer may read a block-scope CONST object's value exactly as it may read a file-scope one's — the object const and not volatile, its own initializer a constant. DSS refused every shape with H_StaticInitializerNotFolded: a local's const-ness was recorded nowhere in HIR, and the static-data producer read module objects only. The exit code is a bitmask of the shapes that did not fold (1 a scalar, 2 an element, 4 a member, 8 a chain `b = a + 2`, 16 a nested block and a shadowed name, 32 a whole-structure copy, 64 an enumeration-typed const, 128 a const local pointer holding a file-scope object's address, 256 a volatile MEMBER of a const local, 512 an array whose initializer names a const). No one reference builds the whole file — it is the union: MEASURED 2026-09-30 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, its gcc subset (8 and 512 dropped) runs 42 on gcc 13.3.0 at -std=c17 -pedantic-errors and -std=c2x, and its clang subset (256 dropped) runs 42 on clang 18.1.3 in both modes (run 20260930-235759-eb96e0c4); MSVC 19.51 refuses every shape (C2099, run 20260930-235710-78f93967). Every operand comes from argc. The release arm is REPORT-ONLY: the statics are folded data either way; its value is that the optimized pipeline reads them back unchanged.
